top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain: Holst on secretion and incretin action in humans, Mojsov on identifying the active 7-36 peptide, Drucker on the biology of proglucagon-derived peptides. Outcome trials show benefit for glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and kidney disease. The three-laureate allocation with a discovery-focused citation fits the scientific record and avoids the attribution problems of adding a fourth name or a second part; no award would withhold a clearly deserving, fully mature achievement.
